offer.text: I've strayed too far and the light's failing. I know the way back — just keep close and keep the monsters off me, and I'll lead us home.

accept.text: Stay near me. I'll set the pace.

decline.text: Then I'll find my own way, and hope for the best.

in_progress.text: This way — and don't let anything creep up behind us.

ready.text: Home, and in one piece! I knew I could count on you.

complete.text: Safe behind the walls at last. I won't forget this kindness.

failed.text: We never made it... I was lucky to crawl away. Another time, perhaps.
